text:
A young man went to a wise teacher. “I want to learn everything,” he said. “Please teach me.”

The teacher smiled. “Let’s have some tea first,” he said.

He brought a cup and began to pour tea. The cup was full, but he kept pouring. Tea ran over the table and onto the floor.

“Stop!” said the young man. “The cup is full. It cannot hold any more!”

“Yes,” said the teacher. “You are like this cup. You are full of your own ideas and opinions. How can I give you something new?”

The young man was quiet.

“If you want to learn,” said the teacher, “first empty your cup. Listen with an open mind.”

The young man bowed. He understood. From that day, he listened carefully and asked many questions. He became a wise man, too.

Moral: To learn something new, keep your mind open.
